summary: Enhance your skills in data collection and management with our CommCare course. Learn to streamline processes and improve data accuracy effectively.
lede: CommCare data collection training helps app builders, monitoring and evaluation officers, and field coordinators configure field workflows. Participants build validated forms, link submissions to longitudinal cases, test offline synchronization, and review exports for completeness and timeliness. They also map user roles, document personal-data controls, and prepare reporting handovers and implementation plans.
audienceIntro: Mobile data collection professionals who design, supervise, administer, analyse, or improve field information workflows will benefit from this practical course. It suits foundation-to-intermediate users who need to configure CommCare safely without becoming software developers.
prerequisites: Prior experience with spreadsheets, field operations, programme monitoring, research, or data administration is useful but not mandatory. No programming or software development experience is required. You should bring a laptop with a modern web browser and access to a suitable training environment. The course focuses on configuration and operational application rather than technical engineering or production-scale integration.
